data.description:
Job Description:


ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:  


Support the development of front-end features using React.js. 


Assist in building backend services and APIs using Node.js and Express. 


Work with MongoDB for data handling and storage. 


Perform debugging, testing, and documentation of code. 


Collaborate with team members to understand requirements and deliver tasks within deadlines. 


Follow coding standards and participate in code reviews. 


Continuously learn tools, technologies, and best practices related to the MERN

data.title: IT Engineer
data.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior IT Engineer to manage and support the organization's IT infrastructure, ensuring the availability, security, and performance of systems, networks, and end-user services. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting skills, and experience leading IT projects and mentoring junior team members.

 

 

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain the organization's IT infrastructure, including Windows/Linux servers, network infrastructure, storage systems, Microsoft 365 services, endpoint security solutions, and enterprise applications.
